title: Solutions + Pro Services Weekly Sync — Customer Integration Status (2026-03-10)
content:
Date: 2026-03-10
Attendees: Maya T., Jared L., Priya P., Evan M., Zoe K., Alex R. (ops)
Duration: 60m

Purpose: Weekly Solutions + Professional Services sync focused on customer integration statuses, escalations, and next steps. Informal notes / action list for the team.

Summary notes:
- Quick wins: two customers (Acme, RetailCo) moved from initial staging to extended soak; basic metrics look good.
- Main escalations this week revolve around SSO cert chain issues, Dedicated capacity ETA, and an odd latency regression on the quantized model for long-context prompts.

Customer-by-customer statuses:
1) Acme (e-commerce search / personalization) — Owner: Jared L.
   - Current phase: Staging (soak testing)
   - Progress: End-to-end flow validated: ingest -> embed -> re-rank -> generate snippets. Smoke tests passed.
   - Blockers: SAML SSO integration failing for some users due to intermediate CA mismatch (error: INVALID_CERT_CHAIN). IdP team raised a ticket; they pushed new metadata Tuesday but test users still fail intermittently.
   - Performance: 95th percentile tail at 210ms on hosted small model; with same prompts on dedicated rtx-a5000 pool we saw 130ms — meets SLA target once dedicated is live.
   - Next steps: Jared to coordinate with IdP (contact: steph@acme.com) for full cert chain by 2026-03-12. If unresolved, fallback: temporary invite-only access with API keys for pilot.
   - Action item: Jared L. — follow up with Acme IdP and confirm cert chain by 2026-03-12.

2) FinCorp (financial analytics) — Owner: Priya P.
   - Current phase: Security review / private deployment planning
   - Progress: Signed DPA and LOI; infra team started VPC peering questionnaire. Customer requires HSM-backed KMS and audit-forwarding to Splunk.
   - Blockers: Compliance requested additional proof-of-concepts for data-at-rest encryption in private deployment; they want full disk encryption + customer-managed KMS example.
   - Performance/Model notes: Customer prefers a quantized fp8 variant to reduce costs. Initial local quantized run shows a 6% quality delta on a finance-specific eval set for long rationales. Needs QA signoff.
   - Next steps: Schedule security demo w/ infra (Alex R.) and security (Evan M.) for 2026-03-15. Prepare PoC document highlighting KMS flow and audit logs.
   - Action item: Priya P. — assemble PoC repo and run quantized evals; due 2026-03-14. Evan M. — attend security demo and prepare remediation checklist.

3) HealthCo (healthcare SaaS) — Owner: Evan M.
   - Current phase: Early integration / legal review
   - Progress: NDA in place; privacy questionnaire in progress. They requested on-prem bundle for one environment (air-gapped).
   - Blockers: On-prem packaging requires additional installer testing for their older RHEL 7 fleet. Release engineering needs to validate compatibility. Also need to ensure audit log format meets their EHR ingestion pipeline.
   - Next steps: Release-eng to run full install matrix and provide a minimal reproducible environment by 2026-03-20. Solutions team to prototype an export-to-EHR sample.
   - Action item: Evan M. — collect RHEL instance specs and hand off to release-eng (ticket created: REL-319).

4) RetailCo (catalog generation) — Owner: Zoe K.
   - Current phase: Canary rollout on Dedicated (50 QPS)
   - Progress: Canary showing 0.4% error rate (mostly transient network timeouts). Latency targets met. Observability dashboards configured.
   - Blockers: Autoscaling policy needs tuning; burst policy not kicking in expectedly under synthetic burst tests. Infra suspects a misconfigured concurrency limit in the autoscaler config.
   - Action item: Zoe K. + Alex R. to validate autoscaler config and run a second round of bursts by 2026-03-11.

Platform / infra notes:
- Dedicated provisioning: Ops reports constrained capacity for one cluster (eu-west-1) due to a vendor inventory delay. Expected resolution: 2026-03-18. We need to notify impacted customers if timelines slip.
- Observability: New tracing hook landed in staging; requires minor SDK bump (client v1.8.2) — PR #73 in integration-scripts. Rollout plan: canary for 48h, then wide.
- Performance regression: Spike in token-generation latency for quantized long-context runs observed on 2026-03-08. Preliminary root cause points to KV-cache eviction thresholds interacting poorly with longer prompts. Ben (serving-runtime) assigned to deeper profiling.

Decisions made:
- For customers with fragile SSO (Acme), proceed with API-key fallback for pilot if IdP cert chain cannot be fixed within 48 hours.
- For FinCorp quantization concerns: permit a short-term A/B with non-quantized baseline for critical reports until QA matures the quantized model.

Open questions / Risks:
- If vendor capacity delay pushes past 03/18, which customers should be prioritized for EU capacity? (Propose: FinCorp, RetailCo)
- Need final sign-off criteria for HealthCo on-prem acceptance (who on release-eng will own final acceptance?)

Action items (consolidated):
- Jared L.: Confirm Acme IdP cert chain by 2026-03-12. (If not resolved, enable API-key pilot)
- Priya P.: Assemble FinCorp PoC (KMS + audit logs) and run quantized evals by 2026-03-14.
- Evan M.: Collect HealthCo RHEL specs and open REL-319 follow-up; attend security demo 03/15.
- Zoe K. + Alex R.: Re-run autoscaler burst tests and validate policies by 2026-03-11.
- Ben (serving-runtime): Profile KV-cache eviction behavior and provide mitigation plan by 2026-03-16.
- Maya T.: Draft customer notification (EU capacity ETA) if vendor update slips beyond 03/18; circulate for review by 2026-03-13.

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Add a short checklist in Confluence for on-prem acceptance testing for HealthCo (owner: release-eng).
- Schedule a mid-week async update for customers in staging so they have visibility on the SSO/infra work.

Next meeting: 2026-03-17, 10:00am PT — same agenda + progress on action items.

Raw chat logs / references (copied links & tickets):
- JIRA: JIRA-SEV-1284 (quantized latency regression)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-PCS-4821 (FinCorp PoC design)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/integration-scripts/pull/73

End of notes.
